finding.obstruction: Treating v0(X,eta) and U(X,eta) as independent free profile families does not generically preserve incompressibility.
finding.minimal_structural_fix: Parameterize the poloidal sector with one scalar similarity streamfunction Phi via psi=q^(1/2-h) X Phi; keep F as the independent swirl profile.
finding.parameter_effect: For an N-mode poloidal basis this replaces two independently fitted N-mode profile blocks (v0 and U) by one N-mode Phi block while enforcing the profile-space divergence identity exactly.
finding.axis_regular: The derived v0/U map contains no 1/X division when psi=q^(1/2-h) X Phi, so finite Phi jets stay regular at X=0.
finding.visualization_handoff: Use Phi basis growth for radial/axial morphology and a separate F basis for swirl. Do not add unconstrained independent v0/U modes unless the divergence identity is imposed explicitly.

truth_boundary: This increment changes no production candidate and therefore does not yet improve measured visual similarity. It narrows the next basis-growth search to a divergence-preserving poloidal scalar plus independent swirl, without validating Navier-Stokes or identifying the OpenAI field.
